block64.control: same candidate object programs in original per-object ZIP layout

block256.control: same candidate object programs in original per-object ZIP layout

rules.save_cpu_gate: paired log(candidate/baseline), Student t one-sided 95% upper bound strictly below log(1.01)
rules.confidence_scope: Individual per-case intervals, not a joint familywise claim
rules.save_boundary: Game.saveGame entry through returned save coroutine with pipe, waiton, and on_done drained
rules.load_boundary: Savefile.loadGame entry through execution of its delayed callback queue
rules.load_control: Exact candidate object programs materialized into stock per-object ZIP entries; same DLC/addons and source save
rules.measurement: Fresh home/process each session; Linux LuaJIT 2.0.2; Xvfb/llvmpipe; no trace audit, native verification, latency instrumentation, or profiler
rules.memory: ru_maxrss at before/after save is process-lifetime peak, including load; Lua values are boundary heap sizes, not peaks
rules.sample_policy: Keep all valid pairs; no trimming, pooling, extending, or replacing samples after observing outcomes. Any invalid session stops this declared run.
rules.scenarios: 64 KiB and 256 KiB targets compared separately; only game.teag changes layout; no inventory/Fearscape events
rules.followups: Separate correctness/fault/latency checks do not enter formal timing samples

limitations: One Linux/llvmpipe character fixture; no Windows or hardware GPU claim
New block files require the prototype reader; stock-without-addon failure safety is not delivered
Peak RSS includes process loading; Lua measurements are boundary sizes, not peaks
No injected storage faults or cloud synchronization inside the formal cohort
Experimental files only; production package/defaults are unchanged
